metadata.label: Cosmos Starfield
metadata.description: Layered fine stars and fixed six-ray feature stars on deep black.

controlDescriptions.featureStarDensity: Reveals the twelve stable feature stars in sequence, including fractional fades.
controlDescriptions.featureStarOpacity: Fades the feature-star layer independently of the fine stars.
controlDescriptions.featureStarScale: Scales all six-ray feature stars while preserving their size distribution.
controlDescriptions.featureStarVariance: Controls how strongly the stable feature-star sizes differ.
controlDescriptions.starlight: Sets the opacity of the three fine-star depth layers.
controlDescriptions.twinkle: Adds a slow, subtle brightness drift without moving the fixed sky.
